tracks.title: HBG renewal eligibility
tracks.summary: Rules for when a renewal lease does not get an HBG policy. The working list is still being confirmed with insurance ops. This is a warning to the property, plus a block, not a silent skip.
tracks.nextStep: Confirm the block list with insurance ops. Dan asked #leap-entrata for scenarios that should not renew.

updates.text: Dan's working block list: property settings disabled; a claim in Open or Closed Paid (other closed statuses still allow renewal); a duplicate policy on another lease before the renewal lease is created. The property should see a warning that the renewal lease is not eligible for HBG and may need a guarantor.
Fraud and student validation are known gaps. They are not in the block list because there is no systemic way to resolve them today.
HBG auto-renewal must not work like DA auto-renewal. A renewal lease interval must exist. No month-to-month, including a roll to month-to-month because move-out has not been performed.

tracks.title: Landmark — The Redland Apartments enrollment exceptions
tracks.summary: Landmark asked whether three residents at The Redland Apartments can be manually enrolled or reinstated in HBG after the lease term has already started. LEAP told them a policy cannot be initiated after the lease start date. Alyssa is on the thread for visibility. Owner of the answer is not locked yet.
tracks.nextStep: Alyssa confirms who owns the answer and whether a manual enroll or reinstate is possible. Tickets #1098815 and #1079454.

updates.text: Brad Siddoway raised the ask in #insurance-ops-rnd-collab. The three cases are a renewal transfer that likely missed enrollment during migration, a standard renewal that had a prior policy and was not enrolled on renewal, and a renewal transfer with a signed guarantor waiver addendum that could not be added during renewal. Resident names are intentionally not stored here.
